units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:1:9">Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᶜ</cite> bot. (in Chald. dict.) <he>לא הוה לבן רב וכ׳</he> they would not have dared to do so.

<cite ref="Berakhot 62b:22">Ber. 62ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 24:16">II Sam. XXIV, 16</cite>) the Lord said to the angel, <he>טול לי רב שבהם וכ׳</he> take me the greatest of them in whom there is (merit enough) with which to pay their debts (sins); a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="T00085"><he>רַבִּים</he></cite>, <cite ref="T00095"><he>רַבִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 8b:8">Keth. 8ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ שתו ר׳ ישתו</he> many have drunk (the cup of mourning), many shall drink.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:8">Yeb. 63ᵇ</cite> (from Ben Sira) <he>מנע ר׳ מתיך וכ׳</he> keep the many off thy house, nor bring every body to thy house.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ר׳ יהיו דורשי וכ׳</he> let thy well-wishers be many, but reveal a secret to one out of a thousand.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 43b:17">Ab. Zar. 43ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>ר׳ שאני</he> where several people meet to pray, it is different.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 43b:17">Ib.</cite> <he>שכיחי ר׳ גביה</he> many people are usually with him.
Ber. 9ᵃ, a. fr. יחיד ור׳, v. יָחִיד; a. fr.—Esp. רַבִּים community, public.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 3:1:4">Y. Meg. III, 73ᵈ</cite> <he>בה״כ של ר׳</he> a synagogue belonging to a community, opp. <he>של יחיד</he>. Bab.
<cite ref="Megillah 28b:1">Meg. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>הספד של ר׳</he> funeral ceremonies in a case of public mourning (for a public man), opp. <he>של יחיד</he>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:4">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>צריך … לר׳ ור׳ וכ׳</he> should make his trouble known to the people, and the people will pray for him.
Ber. 8ᵃ תפלתן של ר׳ congregational prayer; a. v. fr.—בָּרַ׳ in public.
B. Mets. 58ᵇ, v. לָבָן II; a. fr.—Fem. רַבָּה.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 33:7">Gen. R. s. 33</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 36:7">Ps. XXXVI, 7</cite>) <he>את מדקדק … עד תהום ר׳</he> thou dealest strictly with them (the wicked) (searching their doings) ‘to the great deep’; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Psalms 36:7">Ib.</cite> s. 27, v. <cite ref="T00046"><he>רָבַב</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>רַבּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Chagigah 5a:16">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 31:21">Deut. XXXI, 21</cite>) <he>צרות ר׳ ורעות</he> Ms. M. many troubles and evils, v. <cite ref="M02262"><he>מָצָא</he></cite>; a. e.—[<he>מדרש רַבּיֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="M00337"><he>מִדְרָשׁ</he></cite>.]
